name: dvstack
description: Skills and working examples for front-end work, test automation, and agent ops, collected from real projects.

plugins.name: dvstack-frontend
plugins.description: Front-end skills that ship with working source files: the agent copies proven code into your project instead of rewriting it from scratch.

plugins.name: dvstack-testing
plugins.description: Playwright end-to-end skills: naming conventions, suite architecture, test strategy, step validation and waiting, fixtures, locators, API-driven setup, network mocking, hard interactions, accessibility, visual testing, debugging, flaky-test triage, CI sharding, and a code-review checklist.

plugins.name: dvstack-agents
plugins.description: Global agent-ops habits for any coding tool: cost discipline that never trades away quality, throwaway vs production bar, outcome-first steering, verify loops, encoding misses into skills, proof-first rigor for harnesses, live verification, and design exploration, plus session and token hygiene.

plugins.name: dvstack-harness
plugins.description: The system around coding agents: task contracts, tool gates, verify/recover, durable state, and change receipts. Light by default; skip for short low-risk tasks.
